notes.notes:
Hey Survivors,

We hope you’re all comfortable and well fed within your bunkers! 
The team have just released a new hotfix patch for the game, fixing some bugs and adding further quality of life improvements.

Full details can be found below:
[list]
[*]Added d-pad button shortcut for answering radio
[*]Added controller icons to the recycling output panel
[*]Removed the buttons from the bottom of the customisation page (when using gamepad)
[*]Fixed an issue where a second incinerator would appear in Surrounded mode
[*]Fixed an issue with the Scientist’s speech bubble in Stasis
[*]Fixed an issue where the generator would duplicate itself
[*]Change to camera pan position for Macroy’s cutscene
[*]Boss avatar image fix in Surrounded
[*]Removed green circle marker for combat
[*]Fixed an issue where the wardrobe was removing hazmat suit textures
[*]Fixed an issue to the character’s avatar when you customise appearance using the wardrobe whilst wearing a hazmat suit
[*]Fixed an issue with locations not being lootable when an NPC runs from an intimidation attempt
[*]Fixed an issue where the item bin would duplicate meat
[*]Fix for hazmat suit 1 not saving in the hazmat bay
[*]Updated size of text boxes for items needed (lab, ammo, upgrade panels)
[*]Equipping binoculars on the map equipment screen will now have immediate effect on the parties’ sight range
[*]Fixed an issue with the Stasis Power Core cutscene
[*]Fixed an issue in Stasis for family members forgetting they were dead when returning from a lost expedition
[*]Fixed an issue where the player could click the radio icon when there is another panel on the stack
[*]Items that are crafted but cannot to be added to inventory are now added to item bin
[*]Fixed an issue where an expedition party would not return when a mutant lurker is present at shelter and there are no surviving members left in the shelter
[*]Players cannot deconstruct shelter storage if it would result in item loss to stop them from losing items
[*]Fixed several issues with the missing family member quest
[*]Bug fix for expedition set up running out of grid space for food, meats and water
[*]Fixed an issue where NPC’s are assigned the same trait
[*]Fixed an issue where characters could become stuck when leaving the shelter
[*]Missing family member quest will no longer spawn when scanning on the radio when no family members are missing
[*]Players are no longer be able to start an encounter with a mutant by the radio and then start a second one on the surface during the transition period between encounters
[*]Minor localisation fixes to items
[*]Fixed an issue where the dog was showing as having ammo on first turn during combat
[*]Fixed an issue with the Boss cutscene in Surrounded
[*]Fixed an issue where dead characters would be able to enter shelter combat
[*]Small text changes throughout the game
[*]Fixed an issue where parties would become stuck if they tried to start a quest that had been removed.
[*]Fixed an issue where laser weapons where showing up with useable combat items 
[/list]
We hope these fixes and tweaks make your life in the apocalyptic ruins of Earth that little bit more comfortable. 

Happy scavenging!

If you’re reading these patch notes and are yet to move into your own family sized apocalyptic bunker, there’s never been a better time as Sheltered is currently 75% off until 22nd July.

notes.title: Sheltered Update v1.8 - New Game Mode: Stasis
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/42439ff97f11236fce73ec740120205f6372fde0.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]New Game Mode – Stasis[/b][/h1]

Survivors,

Earth is dying. There will be no recovering from the apocalypse that man has unleashed onto the world.

The land is swarming with mutated people and animals, the weather conditions become more extreme week by week and resources have become all but non-existent.

Earth is no longer a home, you must reach out to the stars and find a new one…

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/c598d96627a7a2398274f64963da83ba0449d7a3.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sheltered: Stasis - Objectives[/h1]

In Stasis, our second scenario for Sheltered, you’ll be tasked with building and launching a rocket to leave Earth. 

The game will be complete if you successfully find all the rocket parts and launch the rocket, or, if your family dies/become unconscious. There are eight different endings for Stasis, depending on the success, or failure, of your mission. 

You’ll have 75 days to complete your mission before your shelter can no longer protect your family.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/8b518f0c62a35894282fc17322b0bab89fe4a734.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Features[/h1]

[b]Wardrobe[/b]
This allows the player to change the outfits/colours of their characters during the game. It must first be crafted by the player using the crafting bench. 

[b]New planter functionality (With new fertilizer item)[/b]
[list]
[*]The planter now has a new added state - ‘Wilting’, before it dies. 
[*]The planter can now use fertiliser to increase the yield of harvest. 
[*]The planter can now be harvested at any time (so long as there is something to harvest)
[/list]
[b]New UI label is displayed on the map for visited locations showing what items the location can contain (survival mode only).[/b]
[list]
[*]This also tells the player which equipment they’ll need to unlock a hidden item (Stasis AND Survival). 
[/list]
[b]Changing a party members loadout (weapon, equipped items and load carrying items) is now possible during an expedition (Using view map).[/b]

[b]Clipboard now shows more information.[/b]
[list]
[*]There is a second tab on the clipboard panel. It shows the family stats and needs.
[/list]
[b]Unlockable, hidden items at locations (Require lockpick set, prospectors kit etc)[/b]
[list]
Locations with hidden items now show a question mark icon, which tells the player what they need to do to unlock the hidden items. The player can come back with appropriate equipment to unlock it.
[/list]
[b]Radio auto resolves now give the player more information (If someone was lost in the wasteland etc)[/b]

[b]Characters lost in the wasteland now spawn a quest in which you can release them from a prison. The character will then return to the shelter.[/b]

[b]Characters can now eat meat from animal traps without having to first create a freezer.[/b]
[list]
[*]Other items harvested (leather) at that time will go into storage like normal
[/list]
[b]New Icon & text for damage taken from bleeding, suffocation and radiation will display when a character is in the shelter. [/b]
[list]
[*]-1 health will appear above their head as floating text
[/list]
[b]Players can now reload their gun during combat (wasteland only). Ammunition is now present on the UI during combat, as is equipped armour.[/b]
[list]
[*]We display ammo in the clip and ammo in party storage 
[/list]
[b]Item Bin[/b]
[list]
[*]The item bin is a new addition to the main survival mode. It is a solution to a problem we’ve had with player’s having to lose items when they return, and their storage is full. Now, any excess items not added to the main storage are added to the item bin on the surface. When it contains items, the lid appears off. When it’s empty the lid is on. Items contained are essentially an extended storage for the player, but items are regularly taken by passing people on the surface. The more items in the bin, when the bin men arrive, the more items they take.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]

[b]Survival[/b]
[list]
[*]Fix for missing child quest locking the game up when finding the child.
[*]Fix for gas masks not showing up on character sprites during encounters (if equipped).
[*]Fix for items going missing when an expedition returns if their inventory was full and they equipped a gas mask.
[*]Fix for crash sites re-spawning at the same location when completed.
[*]Characters permanently becoming sideways when deconstructing a bed that is being slept in.
[*]Glitch where a single frame of the climbing out of the hatch animation would disappear. 
[*]Fix for weapons going missing when equipping them mid-expedition (using the map screen) if the player has full inventory and already has a weapon equipped.
[*]Fix for NPC's weapons not appearing at the feet of the character who dropped them when disarmed in combat.
[*]Hidden items should now work as expected when using a controller.
[*]Journal/ Family status panel full controller support added.
[*]Updated the planter’s hover-over text to have “plant condition” & “soil condition”
[*]Fixed an issue with the planter where un-fertilised seeds would give less food/seeds/plants on stage 3 than stage 2
[*]Fixed a bug where you wouldn’t be able to search a location which only had hidden items in it
[*]Other minor bug fixes and improvements
[/list]

[h1]One Last Thing…[/h1]

We’d like to say a huge thank you to all our players who took part in the Stasis beta and shared their feedback with us. You rock!

To those survivors looking to escape Earth for the first time… Good luck, the wasteland just got a lot more dangerous.

notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/404a2b98ed011c08c78e16083f0f65ba071c89d0.gif[/img]

[h1][b]Surrounded – New Mode![/b][/h1]
A new scenario has arrived as a free update for all Sheltered players!

[h1]You’re Surrounded…[/h1]

A family of three, desperately low on supplies, makes the tough decision to split-up. The father heads out into the wilderness to look for the vital supplies that will keep his family alive, telling them he’ll be back in 50 days with the resources to save them from starvation.
The remaining family members, a mother and son, barricade themselves into their shelter, desperate to keep the horrors of the apocalypse at bay...but it’s not just the mutated and starving beasts they should fear.

Seeing the family temporarily separated and weakened, gangs of bandits and marauders put their plans into action to try and evict the family from their shelter, by [i]any[/i] means necessary. The family have faced bandits in the past, but something is different this time. These groups have found themselves bosses, powerful individuals that won’t go down easily…

50 Days

Limited supplies

No way to replenish your water

You are alone

You are surrounded...

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/8c2f2dbc95de15e32790eb27d7590a899a8cb8fc.png[/img]
 

[h1][b]Gameplay Changes for Surrounded – From Beta to Release[/b][/h1]

We just want to say a huge thank you to all the players who took the time to play and share their feedback during the beta for Surrounded. Your feedback has helped us craft the new Surrounded game mode into what it is today.
[list]
[*]Toybox and bookshelf are now deconstructable from the start for the scenario.
[*]Bosses now breach the shelter alone. 
[*]Bosses do significantly more damage to the shelter doors.
[*]Bosses now take significantly less damage in combat - Each boss has separate resistance during combat.
[*]Bosses will no longer fire a full clip during combat. 
[*]Animals will only spawn every 3 days. 
[*]Secret locations will no longer disappear when the player reloads the game.
[*]Food and petrol now award 10 score for every unit the player has remaining at the end of the game.
[*]Added controller support.
[*]It no longer rains in the game. The player must make do with their starting amount of water for the duration of the game.
[/list]
[h1][b]Bug Fixes for Surrounded – From Beta to Release[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Fixing upgraded doors will no longer revert back to previous tier sprites.
[*]Fixed ladder layering issue - characters should no longer appear in front of the dirt overlay sprite.
[*]Fixed issue where players could queue incinerating job on a corpse twice. 
[/list]
[h1][b]Gameplay Changes for Survival Mode (main game) [/b][/h1]
[list]
[*]Door alarm only sounds when the doors are broken. 
[*]Breachers will now trigger combat on ladders if they are colliding with the player.
[*]Can no longer equip ammunition without first equipping a firearm.
[*]Various object collider changes - some objects had much larger colliders than their sprites. Allows more efficient use of space when arranging the shelter.  
[*]Punch bag XP gained from using the punching back has been reduced by 50.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/74a82c1290af66304a4c4f9bf01c520910f1d2ad.png[/img]

notes.title: Sheltered Update 6 Beta Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/3662fb088001ac93bb59334048db9470f5f87f12.jpg[/img]
[h1]Sheltered Update 6 Beta Patch notes [/h1]
Thank you to everyone for your feedback for the Sheltered Update 6 Beta.
We have made the following changes based on your input.

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*]Clicking on a location on the map previously visited locking the game 
[*]Trap damage to bosses has been reduced
[*]Fixed issues with Cole’s cowardice and skipping boss battles
[*]The ability to open map with ‘U’ key has been removed.
[*]Wrong avatars displaying incorrect character in breach combat.
[*]Fixed the pathfinding to unconscious character’s location.
[*]Combat will no longer be triggered when breachers or family members are using ladders.
[*]Certain upgradable objects within the main game saves should be consistent with the original save file.
[*]Defeating 'The Maniac' in combat now gives survivors items as a reward.
[/list]

[b]Unfortunately this new update for Sheltered Update 6 will be only accessible via Windows PC. Update 6 will be ready for playing on Linux and OSX when it is officially released.[/b]

[h1]Accessing the Beta[/h1]
Follow the steps below to back up your save files and then join us in the Sheltered Update 6 Beta
If you want to take part in this exciting update, please [b]BACK UP YOUR SAVE FILES.[/b] 

[b]IMPORTANT How to back up your Save Files![/b]
[list]
[*]Open Steam, right click Sheltered and select Properties
[*]Select Local files
[*]Browser Local Files
[*]Save Folder
[*]Copy and back up the file or drag the save file to the desktop
[/list]

[b]Access the Beta[/b]
[list]
[*]Open Steam, right click Sheltered and select Properties
[*]Select BETA
[*]Enter the code ShelteredSurrounded
[*]Select surrounded_beta – Surrounded Beta via the drop-down menu
[/list]

Please remember this is a Beta, bugs are likely to occur. We want to hear your feedback and suggestions on this new game mode. Please add all your feedback to this post here. [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/356040/discussions/0/2549465882920460138/]Feedback[/url]

To report crashes and other issues, please head here: [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/356040/discussions/1/]Report A Problem[/url] and add Beta 6 to the start of your thread to report back to us.

notes.title: Sheltered Update V1.6 - New Instances, Items and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/9585530/d6b1d2c3bb888a36d36f0d9236912f59daea9811.gif[/img]
Hey Survivors,

The team have been hard at work bringing you the next update to Sheltered. 

Now the time has come for you to take on the fruits of their labour.

This patch brings with it changes to Shelter Breach combat, new instances that your family may experience during expeditions and the addition of new items to aid you in the apocalypse. 

We also squished some more pesky bugs to make the whole Sheltered experience smoother.

[h1]Gameplay Updates & Changes[/h1]

[b]Breaches[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to equip family members when they enter Shelter Breach combat
[*]An equip menu will be shown when a character collides with an attacker
[/list]
[b]Convoy & Helicopter Crash Sites[/b]
[list]
[*]Added randomly occurring crash sites where special items can be found (Advanced Gas Mask & Military Rucksack)
[*]They are randomly spawned in mountains
[/list]
[b]Game Speed[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to slow time
[*]Keyboard Shortcut = Caps Lock
[*]Gamepad = D-Pad Right
[/list]
[b]Camper Van[/b]
[list]
[*]Increased inventory from 52 to 72
[/list]
[b]Fire[/b]
[list]
[*]Reduced the burn time for all burnable objects by 50%
[*]Increased the time it takes to extinguish a fire (by hand)
[*]Increased water cost for extinguishing a fire (by hand)
[/list]
[b]New Items[/b]
[list]
[*]Adrenalin: Gives the user a Strength and Dexterity boost in combat
[*]Advanced Gas Mask: Unlimited use gas mask
[*]Military Rucksack: Has 24 inventory slots
[*]Animal Repellent: If equipped to a party, it will reduce the chance of animal encounters by 90%. Note: Can only be crafted from the laboratory.
[*]Soap: Adds the “shower with soap” function to showers. If you shower with soap it takes half the time! Note: Can be crafted at the laboratory or found at locations.
[*]Animal Fat: Can be harvested from snared animals or found on bears and wolves after combat. Note: Used to create soap and animal repellent.
[/list]
[b]Saving Family Customisation[/b]
[list]
[*]Added the ability to save a family customisation: This pre-set can then be reloaded on the next playthrough. Note: Only one pre-set can be saved.
[/list]
[b]Misc changes[/b]
[list]
[*]Perception experience can now be gained when reading books
[*]Added random character conversations whilst idling
[*]Gas masks now appear on characters who wear them on expeditions
[*]Soap can be discovered at Houses (Sml, Med & Lrg) and randomly at other locations across the map
[*]Adrenalin can be discovered at Barracks, Pharmacies (Sml & Lrg) and Hospitals
[*]Updated the controls screens to show the Slow Time button
[*]Added 8 soap to starting inventory of new saves
[*]Updated the deconstruct chances
- Base chance now 60% from 66%
- Resourceful chance now 90% from 99%
- Wasteful chance now 30% from 33%
[*]Updated the controls screen to include the slow time button
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life & Bug Squishing[/h1]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where some action sounds were drowned out in the audio mixer
[*]Fixed audio issues with new recruits
[*]Fixed audio bug during shelter combat
[*]Fixed a bug where a rabbit can become a deer when snared in a trap
[*]Stopped psychopaths from leaving the shelter whilst wearing a hazmat suit: They will now return the hazmat before leaving.
[*]Fixed a bug where the generator would continue to burn fuel whilst broken (integrity at 0%)
[*]Fixed a bug where the pet’s corpse would disappear on death
[*]Fixed a bug where the CCTV object would continue to play the alarm sound
[/list]

Good luck Survivors, we hope these latest changes aid you in your family's quest for survival in the wasteland.

We look forward to reading your feedback on the forums!


[h1]UPDATE: 02/06/17[/h1]

We've provided a quick fix patch for a few more bugs that have cropped up, which you can find below.  

[list]
[*]Advanced gas mask is now functioning correctly – fixed bug where player would get radiation poisoning through it still
[*]Fixed bug where character heads would change upon removing gas masks after an expedition
[*]Fixed bug where if a user saves and exits the game whilst upgrading an object, they can no longer upgrade the object. It's important to note that this is not a retrospective fix, if you are already experiencing upgrade problems then the patch won't change anything, only prevent it from happening in the future. We hope to provide a retrospective fix for this in the next update.
[/list]

[b]Good luck survivors![/b]

notes.title: Sheltered Raids Update V1.1
notes.notes:
[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1477531776572697443/10A245DAC2D6970EA0EA39C83E0A472B45757BFA/]

Sheltered’s now been out just over a month and we’ve been blown away by the response from both the Early Access veteran survivors and those that have just joined the wasteland.

[h1]We’re excited to announce that we’re releasing an update today that adds exciting new elements to the raids system.[/h1]

We’ve been sifting through community feedback since launch and we’ve been hard at work on this update that we hope you’ll be excited about!

So without further ado, here’s the changes in this update:

[h1]Main changes: [/h1][b]
•	1v1 combat now initiates between an inhabitant and a raider when they get close to each other within the shelter.
•	New combat location “The Shelter”.
•	Close quarters weapons can be taken into combat within the shelter if the item is in the shelter inventory when the raid begins. (Weapons are automatically assigned based on strength and damage dealt.)
•	Traps now deal damage instead of killing NPC characters outright.
•	Inhabitants can wear Good and Excellent body armour during shelter combat, if the item is in the shelter inventory when the raid begins.[/b]

[h1]Balancing tweaks and changes: [/h1][b]
•	Inhabitants in the shelter can be controlled during a shelter breach.
o	Inhabitants with the cowardice trait still cannot be controlled during a shelter breach.
•	The murder action has been removed from the NPC raiders.
•	NPC raiders can still steal and break items whilst raiding the shelter.
•	Breach frequency has been tweaked to occur more often.
•	Characters are no longer automated or perform idle walking when a breach occurs.
•	Breachers face the door when breaking into the shelter.
•	Damage text appears next to traps that successfully hit breachers.
•	The amount of items NPCs can steal has been tweaked.[/b]


So you’ll now have the ability to take the raiders on but you still have the opportunity to take advantage of hiding spots or running away from raiders. 

[h1]We’d love to get your feedback on the update and everything Sheltered, so make sure you stop by the discussion forum! And if you like the update please give the announcement a thumbs up![/h1]

Love Dean, Sonny & Team17


*Thanks to survivor Veryinky for the image!

notes.notes:
[h1]Survivors,[/h1]
[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/361780126224483164/3969AA031A77B47C3CB68C3A7531DB9AEA07A6E6/]
We’re really happy to be back in the New Year with the biggest update to Sheltered yet! We’ve been thinking long and hard about the best way of adding in the theme of bloodlines into the game and we even got community members to play the update early to give us some feedback on the direction we were taking it. 

Now we’re super excited to bring you the Bloodlines Update, which gives you the ability to locate and recruit an estranged family member. This means an extra life for your family, as we know what kind of things can go wrong in the wasteland (bear mauling’s etc.). We’ve also added a bunch of quests, new functionality, balancing, and as usual gotten rid of some bugs.

To hear more about the update watch the latest 'Beneath The Surface' 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LkKiLaY-DbU

[h1]New Scenario: Family Ties[/h1][b]

[h1]New Quests[/h1] [b]
•	The Sickness
•	The Doll
•	Arms Dealer
•	On the Road Again (reclaim the RV quest, will only appear on fresh saves) [/b]

[h1]Additional New Features[/h1] [b]
•	New HUD element to distinguish family members from recruited outsiders.
•	New sound effects added for character actions.
•	Weapon descriptions now include stats on damage, accuracy and required strength to wield.
•	New tips added to loading screen.
•	Bedrock now visible beneath bottom floor of fully expanded shelter.
•	Added Kickstarter backer likenesses NPC’s that walk across the top of the shelter.
•	Added zoom function for the mouse wheel.
•	Added ability to discard items from storage.
•	Added ability to view map by pressing M on the keyboard. [/b]

notes.title: Danger Update! *New Video*
notes.notes:
You’ve had it too easy up till now, but everything has just changed with the Danger Update! No longer is your shelter the safe haven it once was, and factions now rule the wasteland. And there’s even bears…yep you heard it right….bears. 

Watch the Beneath the Surface video to get the latest update straight from the team behind Sheltered! 
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=i5jBR6TE7vs
Get comfy in your shelter cus you’re in for a long read!

[h1]Shelter Raids[/h1][b]
•             Raiders can attempt to break into shelter to attack inhabitants or steal food and supplies.
•             The starting shelter door is now a weak, wooden door.
•             The shelter door can now be upgraded to be made stronger and more resilient to attacks. There are 2 further upgrades, a light metal and heavier metal door.
•             New craftable traps to keep them out:
                                                Paint Can Trap
Spike Trap
Shotgun Trap[/b]

[h1]New Radiation and Oxygen Functionality[/h1] [b]
•             Radiation is no longer present at all times. Radiation clouds now accompany dust storms.
•             The oxygen filter is now used to provide oxygen for the shelter instead of clear radiation.
•             Oxygen filter must be upgraded to provide more oxygen as number of people in shelter increases. [/b]

[h1]Recruit Loyalty[/h1] [b]
•             Newly recruited members of the shelter begin in auto-mode. Player must gain their loyalty before they receive full control over them.
•             Recruits can now be dismissed from the shelter.
•             Recruits that become too stressed or unhealthy will leave the shelter.
•             When recruits leave, there is now a chance they may steal something or sabotage an object.
•             There is now a chance that a recruit is a psychopath and may sabotage the shelter or kill a family member if triggered. [/b]

[h1]New Pet[/h1] [b]
•             Player can now select a Horse as the shelter pet. [/b]

[h1]Factions[/h1] [b]
•             Certain areas of the map are now controlled by dangerous factions.
•             Each faction have new and unique visuals and dialogue. 
•             Factions are generally aggressive and like to jump into combat.[/b]

[h1]Additional New Features[/h1] [b]
•             Doors now open automatically for characters. 
•             Saddle and stable are craftable if the player starts with the horse.
•             Damaged objects may now catch fire.
•             Fire extinguisher is now craftable to put out fires.
•             Expedition parties may now encounter wolves and bears.
•             Added a ‘Move All’ option when transferring items. [/b]

[h1]Bug Fixes including: [/h1] [b]
•             The dog no longer targets dead enemies.
•             The Bucket toilet now remains full when exiting and reloading the game.
•             Player can now change first character in expedition set up if the second is wearing the hazmat suit.
•             Paint no longer refreshes on save data load.
•             Character no longer gains incompletable clean task if another character grabs the mop first.
•             NPCs can no longer target the dog in combat.
•             Two pieces of trash are no longer created when character cooks at Stove.
•             Player no longer loses items when trading matching item with full inventory.
•             Incinerator can now be moved in 'Rearrange Shelter' mode
•             UI for switching between characters in encounters now added.
•             Children’s animation when filling the pet bowl now displays correctly.
•             Recall party is no longer cancelled if player exits the game then loads save data.
•             No longer possible to send out 2 separate parties and use the camper van on both expeditions.
•             Characters with guns will no longer shoot at enemies that have died in the same turn in combat.
•             Correct stat icon now used at encounter results screen.
•             Attention icon for the intercom no longer overlays the encounter screen.
•             Characters now correctly receive trauma if NPC in encounter is killed by bleeding.
•             SFX for the freezers is now correctly controlled by the SFX sound slider in Options.
•             Bandages now always appear white when used in combat.
•             Paint stripper no longer turns walls grey.
•             Camera can now correctly focus on newly constructed room build built on new floor of left side of shelter.
•             Ladders can now be placed on the right side of shelter rooms.
•             Ladders no longer move position when crafted.
•             No longer possible to craft items in illegal positions.
•             Hair style that previously did not match avatar image now displays correctly.
•             Player is now correctly unable to trade items with NPC’s if there isn’t enough room in inventory.
•             Player can no longer search a location after fleeing from encounter there.
•             The excellent stove can no longer be used when the generator is out of fuel or at 0% integrity .
•             Character's foot no longer intersects stump in the Lumber Yard during encounters.
•             Metal Detector/Gas Mask/Binoculars no longer have a yellow border in the incinerator interface, it is now blue.
•             Selecting promise on The Other Shelter scenario will now allow the NPC to return to the shelter.
•             Hammering animation now plays when an adult female in the hazmat suit fixes a filter.
•             Character’s head now appears correctly when using all beds.
•             Able to move a stack of items for incineration when using incinerator.
•             Binoculars sight bonus remains active on expeditions after saving and loading.
•             The perception counter no longer resets after saving and loading if an expedition is on-going.


[h1]Changes and Balancing[/h1] [b]
•             Characters returning from an expedition now return from the right hand side of the screen instead of the left.
•             Menu music starts earlier.
•             Player can no longer search a location after fleeing from encounter there.
•             Controls screen updated to include new method of automating characters.
•             Automate Hazmat suit is now automatically returned prior to leaving for expeditions.
•             Power cord on 'Small Freezer' no longer appears in front of other objects.
•             Player can no longer repair objects that are in use.
•             Camper Van components are now recyclable 
•             Cursor is now visible when placing shelter rooms, paint and paint stripper when using a gamepad.
•             Base trade value of leather has been changed from 8 to 4.
•             Reduced the time required to fix the Good Shower.
•             Reduced the amount of actions that create message in commentary panel.
•             Unique icons added to distinguish between objects being out of power, disabled or broken.
•             Quests and scenario names now appear when the location is hovered over on the map. [/b]

If you like the update give the post a thumbs up!

Love Sonny, Dean & Team17

notes.title: Combat and Quests Update!
notes.notes:
Survivors!

As we explained in the last announcement, we’ve changed the way that we deliver you updates. We’ve now got to a stage where Steam and Xbox One updates will hit at the same time, with the same content. We’re also splitting our updates into two types, ‘Hatch notes’ and bigger themed updates like this one!

The Combat and Quest update shakes things up in a number of ways. We’ve changed the way the combat looks, with a new interface and new options. You can now steal from enemies, disarm them or even inflict a bleeding status effect on them. There are now quests where NPC’s in the wasteland will give you tasks, so look out for yellow markers on your map. And if you hear a knock on your door, it may be the beginning of a new scenario, a different form of quests with new tasks and challenges. 

[img= http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/392169906048559375/9B2F6BC5C672C98E616A0DF5B5DC7E6603311679/]

Alongside the work we’ve been doing on making new features, we’ve been targeting bugs and tweaking the game to make it an overall better experience. For instance selecting one of the female heads will no longer create an avatar with two heads anymore (not that we discriminate against that kind of thing!)

Right, it’s time to close the hatch and get comfy, you’ve got a big read ahead of you…

[h1][b]New Features[/b][/h1]
•	New Quest Feature - 6 Quests have been added to the game.
•	New Scenario Feature - 3 Scenarios have been added to the game
•	Quest tab added to Journal. Player can use this to track active quests.
•	First Aid Kits can now be crafted.
•	New look for the in-game UI.
•	Bandages added to the game. Bandages are used to remove the ‘Bleeding’ status effect.
•	Menus can now be scrolled through using a mouse wheel. (Steam only)
•	Able to automate characters by using the H key as well as the HOME key.
•	Junk items have been added to the game.
•	Improvements made to encounter user interface to bring it in line with new combat UI.
•	UI style and colouring has been changed. Menus are now brown with white text.
•	Flashbangs can now be crafted at the workbench.
•	Pipe Bombs can now be crafted at the workbench.

[h1][b]Combat Updates[/b][/h1]
•	New Combat UI.
•	Ability to disarm enemies in combat.
•	Ability to steal from enemies in combat.

notes.title: Sheltered- Update #4
notes.notes:
[h1]Wasteland Wanderers,[/h1]

It’s time for a huge update… even bigger than the pile of bodies in the soil above your shelter.

[img=http://images.akamai.steamusercontent.com/ugc/1456139678331015272/DD486565B200B1BCBAE4A8BCD15E82BCE744FDDE/]

We’ve been chuckling over your awesomely dark stories and they've inspired us to add some exciting new changes to Sheltered. You’ll now be able ‘end the suffering’ of a catatonic character (yep, it’s exactly how it sounds…). And when you’ve got all those bodies and barely any food, what is there to do but a little bit of ‘harvesting’? Good job we’ve now changed it so that characters will also become desensitised after rampant cannibalism. Dig in!

[b]New Features:[/b]

•             Characters become desensitised to cannibalism after repeated harvesting of corpses.
•             Characters can end the suffering of another catatonic character.
•             Other family members can continue crafting objects that other character has started.
•             Binoculars and Metal Detectors are now craftable.
•             Rat Traps are now craftable.
•             Characters now explain why they are unable to use punching bag due to them being tired.
•             Lumber Yard is now a discoverable location on the map.
•             New art for shelter visitor interface.
•             Audio feedback added to notify player that third task given to character is not registered.
•             Various actions now have sound effects.
•             Locations now have their available items randomised periodically.
•             Increased number of scrap yards that can be found.
•             Added sound effect for cycling between characters.
•             Added audio to encounter results.
•             The journal will now reflect characters becoming desensitised to murder after repeated killings.
•             Added new background images for the following locations:
                -   Bank
                -   Lumber Yard
                -   Factory

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]

•             Tier 2 shower now uses correct icon at Work Bench.
•             Players can now scroll through their storage inventory.
•             Characters no longer become stuck when two parties return from an expedition at the same time.
•             Added several missing translations.
•             Parties no longer become stuck at locations when 2 separate parties radio in at the same time
•             Player can now scroll through storage inventory when storing items found during expedition.
•             Experience gains and level ups for characters on expeditions no longer appear at top left corner of shelter view.
•             Occupied graves now save correctly after game is exited.
•             Increased experience received from using punch bags  
•             Increased experience received for winning in combat
•             Catatonic characters no longer have a text string in their hover over state.
•             Limited the number of clothing colours available to NPCs to prevent odd coloured garments.
•             Bucket Toilet now consumes less water when cleaned.
•             Changed the stats for characters that are recruited at the shelter so they are similar to those found in the wasteland.
• 	The Journal can now be closed with the ‘X’ button
• 	fixed not being able to close the "locations searched" summary panel
•	fixed several instances of overlapping text labels in other languages across various panels
•	Fixed "owned" count of tools, food, water, books, toys and records when in the item transfer panel
•	The jukebox now works and plays music


We’ve been overwhelmed with all the feedback and crazy ideas for the way we can take this game forward. Your ideas continue to shape the game, so it’s super important that you keep them coming!

Love Sonny, Dean + Team 17

The third game update for Sheltered will soon be knocking on your rad doors. It’s full of tweaks that should make the game a smoother experience (as smooth as surviving in a radiated wasteland can be). And we finally found the keys to the RV, so you can fix it up and take it across the wasteland to travel even further.

[b]Change log:[/b]
• The Game Over screen will now feature an obituary detailing how each family member died.
• Cause of death has been added to the commentary panel when someone dies.
• An information panel has been added to the customisation screen explaining stats and traits.
• An information panel has been added to the final customisation screen explaining pet abilities.
• New paint colours have been added.
• Tool descriptions now state what the tools do (increase fix craft speeds).
• Books, records and toys will now be stored in the mains storage if they don’t have the relevant storing objects.
• New backgrounds have been added and previous backgrounds have been upgraded.
• Tutorial pop ups will explain each illness as they happen.
• When the first person dies a tutorial pop up will explain the different options.
• A tutorial has been added explaining automation.
• The cat/dog bowl will now have a plaque to make it more visible.
• The map will now tell you the last time you visited a location when you hover over it on the map screen.
• A hint will now tell you when there is no water for the shower or toilet when a character tries to use them.
